source.quote: FiiO's own parameters page, read 2026-11-24. « Hardware solution »: « SoC: ESP32-S3, DAC: ES9039Q2M*2, USB decoding: XU316, AMP: OPA1642*2 + TPA6120A*2 ». « Max. supported sampling rate » rows: « USB decoding: 768kHz/32bit; DSD512 »; « Coaxial decoding: 192kHz/24bit; DSD64 »; « Optical decoding: 96kHz/24bit »; « Coaxial output: 96kHz/24bit (USB decoding only) ». The rate block is headed « Max. supported sampling rate (PEQ=OFF) ». A « Filter settings » row reads « Supports 8 filter settings ». Bluetooth row: « Bluetooth receiving (5.4) », codecs « SBC/LDAC ». Nothing about R2R, ladder or delta-sigma.

facts.chip: Two ES9039Q2M (ESS), XMOS XU316 as USB receiver.

device_settings.why: « Supports 8 filter settings » - a count and not one name. No value can be recorded: the setting exists, the eight options are not published, and the ES9039Q2M's own filter menu is a chip feature the maker has not described. It is the second maker in this catalogue to state a filter COUNT and withhold the list, after Berkeley's « multiple digital filter options ».

_les_plafonds_sont_donnes_PEQ_eteint: The rate rows are headed « Max. supported sampling rate (PEQ=OFF) ». The ceilings are therefore stated for a device whose parametric equaliser is OFF, and the maker says elsewhere on its own pages that PEQ is not applied to every path. This catalogue has no way to attach a CONDITION to a ceiling: pcm_max_hz is one number. Recorded because a user running PEQ may not get these figures, and the page is honest enough to say so in its own heading.
